reviewSamples.author: Photo of Eric Ruiz (kiider)
reviewSamples.text:
I cannot say enough good things about this company. Our AC stopped working in the middle of the night, and they came out at 1:00 AM when most companies wouldn’t even answer the phone. From the moment he arrived, it was clear he knew exactly what he was doing. BTW he arrived in 10 minutes, at 1am!

What impressed me the most was his honesty. In a world where it feels like everyone is trying to upsell you, he was straightforward, transparent, and focused solely on fixing the problem. He quickly diagnosed the issue, explained everything in a way that we could understand as new homeowners, and even took the time to show us exactly what was wrong and how he fixed it.

There was absolutely no pressure, no unnecessary recommendations, and no attempt to sell us things we didn’t need. Just honest, professional, and highly knowledgeable service.

The repair was completed quickly, our AC was back up and running, and we were able to get some much-needed sleep. It’s rare to find someone who genuinely cares about helping people the way he does.

If you’re looking for an HVAC technician, stop searching. This is the person you want to call. Honest, reliable, knowledgeable, and available when you need him most. We will absolutely be using him again and recommending him to everyone we know.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Jordon Hernandez
reviewSamples.text: Extremely quick, reliable, and honest. Robert came in and was able to diagnose the issue straight away, was super honest, and had great pricing. I am very appreciative and thankful!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Mark Bertaut
reviewSamples.text: I used him 3 years ago, did a good job. I needed him again, showed up within 30 minutes (he's in the same complex). Fixed it within 1 hr... I can now sleep comfortable tonight...Reliable period...

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Ronald Ceballos
reviewSamples.text: We came home to a broken ac unit on a Friday evening after 5:00 pm. Called Robert who showed up right away, provided a diagnostic at no cost, and repaired our issue within the hour. I highly recommend them, you wont be disappointed.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of John Possis
reviewSamples.text: My AC stopped blowing cold air and I was on the phone looking for an AC technician left and right. Robert from Cal-Air called me back within 30 min, was at my house in less than 30 from our call, and had my system diagnosed with a bad capacitor and I was up and running feeling cool again in less than 2 hours from the initial problem. His pricing is more than fair and he is fast. You can't ask for anything better in hot weather! Robert was super pleasant and I would recommend him to anyone needing AC work of any kind!
